status.detail: The remapped-modifier variant belongs in canonical issue #27612.

judgment.rationale: The symptom belongs to the established Advanced Paste stuck-modifier family already tracked in #27612; #38028, #43220, #42471, #45685, and #46874 were closed into that chain. A separate implementation plan here would duplicate the canonical work.
evidence: The reporter isolates the failure to Advanced Paste plus Caps Lock-to-Ctrl remapping and clears it by pressing the involved modifiers again.
Issue #27612 remains open for modifier keys left logically pressed after Paste as Plain Text.
Several closely matching Advanced Paste sticky-modifier reports were explicitly closed as duplicates of #27612.
judgment.recommended_action: Close this report as a focused duplicate of #27612 while preserving its Keyboard Manager remap variant as evidence there.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys fix may be needed, but it is already owned by the open canonical issue #27612; this artifact should not create a competing plan.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste can leave Shift logically pressed after Caps Lock is remapped to Ctrl and the user invokes Ctrl+Shift+V through that remap.
known_information: PowerToys 0.100.2 on Windows 11; Caps Lock is remapped to Ctrl.
Invoking Advanced Paste with physical Caps Lock+Shift+V can leave Shift logically pressed.
Disabling Advanced Paste while keeping the remap prevents the symptom.
inferences: Advanced Paste modifier release/restore interacts with remapped modifier state, but the exact failing event order is not established here.
issue_context.analysis: The report adds a valuable remapped-Caps-Lock variant, but the user-visible failure and recovery are the same stuck-modifier defect already centralized under #27612.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and automated triage comment through 2026-08-27T03:30:39Z.
Verified #27612 is open and describes modifiers remaining logically pressed after Paste as Plain Text.
Verified #38028 and #43220 were closed as duplicates of #27612; #42471, #45685, and #46874 converge on the same chain.
Reviewed current AdvancedPasteModuleInterface modifier release/restore sequence; the 0.100.2 report postdates that logic.

comment.body: Thanks for documenting the Caps Lock → Ctrl variant and for isolating it to Advanced Paste. This is the same stuck-modifier failure family tracked in #27612, which remains open; related reports #38028, #43220, #42471, #45685, and #46874 have been consolidated there. I suggest closing this issue as a duplicate of #27612 and carrying this remapped-modifier reproduction into that thread so the fix covers both physical and Keyboard Manager-generated modifier input.

title: Advanced Paste can leave Shift stuck with Caps Lock → Ctrl remap
